title: Tenant request identity collation governed Dry Run ingress

phases.objective: Provide the missing trusted-main GitHub ingress that consumes the exact owner authorization for Migration 20260808 tenant-request identity collation and performs authorization bootstrap plus a zero-risk Dry Run without exposing any Apply path.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Trusted-main tooling re-verifies runtime readiness, creates one checksum-bound bootstrap authorization, executes governed_migration_execute in dry_run mode with zero risk, uploads no-secret evidence, and exposes no Apply trigger.
steps: Require the exact Issue #4449 authorization token from OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR association.
Checkout the exact issue-comment event head and rerun the existing read-only readiness lifecycle before any authorization mutation.
Re-pin the reviewed migration checksum, statement count, source PR #6662, source merge SHA, Production migration blob, and exact runtime parity.
Create and approve a short-lived capability envelope scoped only to governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap.
Bootstrap the checksum-bound authorization once and fail closed if an exact durable authorization already exists.
Execute governed_migration_execute with mode=dry_run and assert applies_sql=false plus preflight_risk_count=0.
Upload sanitized evidence without exposing a Migration Apply job, Apply confirmation, provider dispatch, direct SQL surface, credential payload, force push, or Migration 1043 mutation.
assertions: The workflow has contents: read permission and contains no Apply token or Apply execution mode.
The runner calls only the governed authorization bootstrap and governed migration Dry Run surfaces for migration execution.
The migration blob, checksum, statement count, source PR, and source merge are pinned to reviewed values.
A pre-existing durable authorization causes a fail-closed stop rather than replaying the one-shot owner authorization.
No direct SQL or provider dispatch surface is introduced and Migration 1043 is not referenced.
